name: Bass Head
author: Flubsound
description: Deep, heavy but controlled low end for hip-hop, trap, EDM and dub. A 6 dB adaptive sub shelf with headroom protection, harmonic bass so small drivers still convey the notes, and light tightening plus a low-mid cut so it reads as deep rather than muddy. Mono bass below 110 Hz and multiband glue keep the limiter from pumping.
